newsitem.title: USA: Dole says his wife might be next president.
newsitem.headline: Dole says his wife might be next president.

text.p: Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole stumbled in a speech Wednesday and appeared to suggest that his wife Elizabeth might turn out to be the next U.S. president.
At a rally in Tennessee, Dole ended up endorsing his wife.

Referring to President Bill Clinton, the Democratic Party candidate, Dole said: "And then he gave you the big medical care plan, the president, I mean Elizabeth, President Dole talked about, Elizabeth Dole talked about -- she probably will be the next president. But in any event, that's the way it works."
